row.evidence: Azure DevOps documents no SCIM endpoint; organizations connect to Microsoft Entra ID, and when a user leaves an Entra group that was their sole source of access, Azure DevOps automatically removes them from the organization.
row.notes: New row. Pricing is per user licence: Stakeholder access is free, Basic is free for the first 5 users then $6/user/month, Basic + Test Plans is $52/user/month; Visual Studio subscribers and GitHub Enterprise Cloud users get access at no extra cost. There is no SCIM endpoint and no Entra gallery provisioning app; identity comes from connecting the organization to Microsoft Entra ID (sign-in with work credentials on any organization), and Entra group rules assign access levels hourly (dynamic groups up to 24h) and remove users whose only access came from the group. Access from a group rule takes effect on first sign-in. Okta and other IdPs reach Azure DevOps only through Entra ID. sso_plan is Basic because the Entra connection is an organization setting with no plan gate. The Member Entitlement Management and Graph REST APIs add, update, disable and delete users and group entitlements on every organization; the Audit Log API needs an Entra-backed organization.

plans.notes: An access level rather than an organization plan; Entra sign-in and the REST APIs are organization-wide.

plans.name: Basic
plans.price_text: First 5 users free, then $6 per user per month
plans.notes: Audit Log API requires the organization to be backed by Microsoft Entra ID. Billing is monthly through Azure (no annual price listed).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented for Azure DevOps Services. Users come from the connected Microsoft Entra ID tenant (or Microsoft accounts); Entra group rules assign access levels and remove users whose only access came from the group.

auth.notes: Scopes shown on the Member Entitlement Management reference pages; personal access tokens and Entra tokens are also used across Azure DevOps but were not separately cited.

endpoints.purpose: Add a user with licence, extensions and project group
Edit a user's licence, extensions, projects and teams
Delete a user from the organization
Create a group entitlement (group rule) with licence rule
Add a member to a group
Materialize an existing Entra or Microsoft account user (Graph)

audit_log_api.notes: Only for organizations backed by Microsoft Entra ID; events kept 90 days.

rate_limits.text: Global consumption limit: requests are delayed when a user's usage exceeds 200 times a typical user's consumption in a sliding five-minute window (measured in TSTUs).

okta.notes: OIN search for 'azure devops' returns no results.

entra.notes: Not a gallery app: the organization connects directly to an Entra ID tenant; group rules sync access hourly and remove users whose only access came from the group. No Entra SaaS-app tutorial for Azure DevOps exists in the Entra saas-apps index.

fallbacks.other_sync: Microsoft Entra ID directory-backed organization with Entra group rules (hourly sync) that assign access levels and remove users
fallbacks.notes: Users granted by a group rule are materialized on first sign-in, so the mechanism behaves like JIT on top of directory group sync. jit_protocol is recorded as oidc because sign-in is through Microsoft Entra ID; the docs do not name the protocol.
